all_occupations_baseline.title: Total all occupations
all_occupations_baseline.reference_period: 2026 1st Qtr wages (EDD-updated with ECI); employment = May 2025 OEWS estimate

notes: Wages: CA EDD OEWS, Year=2026, Quarter=1st Qtr. EDD states wages were updated to Q1 2026 by applying the US DOL Employment Cost Index; employment estimates are for May 2025.
Percentile keys p10..p90 come from EDD columns named unsafe_*_percentile_wage (CKAN naming artifact; values are ordinary numbers).

Projections: EDD long-term projections; Stockton-Lodi MSA period 2023-2033, California period 2024-2034. total_openings_10yr is the 10-year total (exits + transfers + growth); annual_openings_avg_DERIVED = total/10, computed by Foothold research, not published by EDD.
EDD OEWS is a federal-state cooperative program with BLS. The BLS May 2025 MSA page could not be read by script (see bls_may2025_msa.verify_url).
